change: the two cyber practice sheets are imported and the hub and spoke goes live
_context: The CODE for this shipped in PR #512 and its gate,
rederive and mutation. That gate deliberately carries NO live check, because
nothing it changed is observable on the storefront: the pages do not exist
until a human imports two Matrixify sheets through the Shopify admin.
This is the gate for THAT step, and it is separate on purpose. A content
import is a different deploy from a code deploy, and folding them into one
manifest would have left the code gate red for reasons that had nothing to do
then cyber-practice-hub-links-pages.csv. The hub links point at the five new
handles, so the reverse order publishes two hubs linking five 404s.

checks._why: Every assertion in this script was measured FALSE on 2026-09-04 before any import: all five spoke handles returned 404, ap-cybersecurity-topics linked no practice page at all, and ap-cybersecurity-practice linked none of the five spokes. Run pre-import it reports 7 failures, which is the proof it is not decoration. It also checks the two EXTENDED pages kept their h1 and their FRQ and labs sections, so a MERGE that blanked a live body fails here rather than on a student's screen.

not_covered: Whether any individual practice page teaches well. That is a judgement and no re-check settles it.

Ranking. Whether the practice layer earns traffic without taking it from the concept spokes is a question for Search Console over weeks, not for a gate. The structural half is enforced by rule P1, which refuses a practice page carrying a CED topic title.
The 128 course pages do not yet link onward to their unit's practice spoke. This pass is hub-down by design; the reverse edge is a separate sheet.
